decisions.reasoning: NVDA has sold off ~8% into earnings (from ~$140 to $128.57), creating directional uncertainty. Analyst sentiment is strongly bullish (Dan Ives expects 'clear beat and raise special', Rosenblatt maintains Buy with $220 PT), but historical post-earnings reactions are mixed — 2 of the last 4 quarters saw negative T+2 moves despite EPS beats.
